study_type: Second environment for the ICoDiT 2026 camera-ready (reviewer request for benchmark diversity). Same design, budgets and analysis plan as sensor-extension-2.0; fixed before any Ant branch runs.
parent_protocol: protocol_extension.json (sensor-extension-2.0); all unlisted settings are identical
clean_condition_role: Continued-training control: the same warm start keeps training on unmodified observations (A) with the same interaction and update budget. Its A change measures degradation from continued optimization alone.
noise_units: Absolute observation units: 0.1 for the 13 position coordinates and 0.5 for the 14 velocities, the same rule as HalfCheetah; no fitted normalizer
old_replay_collection: Fresh deterministic clean-condition episodes from the frozen pretrained model; same pool for both replay arms
checkpoint_rule: Fixed budgets only; no selection from sensor-test or retention performance

analysis_plan.replication_unit: Source training seed (n = 8 per controller). Evaluation episodes are averaged within seed first; branches from one source model are not independent.

primary_family.description: Paired retained-replay effect, D = metric(rho=0.5) - metric(rho=0), for each controller x fault x metric
primary_family.test: Two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the 8 seed-level paired differences
primary_family.multiplicity: Holm correction across the 8 cells, family-wise alpha = 0.05
primary_family.estimate: Mean paired difference with a 95% t-interval and a 95% percentile bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of seeds, fixed RNG seed 20261031)
primary_family.effect_size: Mean difference divided by SD of differences (d_z)

secondary_tests: Per arm: Delta_A and Delta_B vs 0 (one-sample exact Wilcoxon, Holm within each metric)
Fault-specific forgetting: Delta_A(fault, rho=0) - Delta_A(clean continuation) per seed (paired exact Wilcoxon, Holm across 4 cells)
Controller comparison (transformer vs reactive) on Delta_A and Delta_B: Mann-Whitney U, descriptive only because capacity, pretraining and initial returns differ
analysis_plan.reporting: All seeds and all branches reported, including declines. p-values are reported with the n = 8 floor (minimum two-sided exact Wilcoxon p = 0.0078) stated. Non-significance is not interpreted as equivalence or absence of forgetting.

inference_limitations: Eight source seeds and five evaluation episodes per condition. Warm-start, single environment, two fixed sensor faults. No equivalence, no-forgetting, success-rate, or arbitrary-new-environment claim.
warm_start_limitations: Source checkpoints were trained on actuator perturbations. A is a clean evaluation condition, not a newly trained clean-only task. Optimizers and entropy temperature were not archived and are initialized anew for every branch.
observation_layout: 27 coordinates: 13 positions (torso height, torso quaternion, 8 joint angles), then 14 velocities; the 78 external contact-force coordinates are excluded
source_training: Ant-v5 transformer and reactive sources trained with the HalfCheetah source recipe (scripts/train_*_source_recipe_v1.py = git 54224e48f trainer versions plus an --env option: 100 iterations, 4 episodes per iteration, UTD 10, actuator-perturbation training faults, validation-selected checkpoint), seeds 42-49
early_termination: Ant-v5 terminates when unhealthy. Collection is step-budgeted: episodes are capped at the next evaluation budget (a truncation, bootstrapped), updates accrue at 0.25 per collected step, and replay samples episodes in proportion to length (uniform over transitions).
